wiki.title: Sean McCann (politician)
wiki.extract: Sean Andrew McCann (born September 21, 1971) is the senator for the Michigan Senate's 19th district. He formerly represented the 20th senate district. He is a former member of the Michigan House of Representatives, who represented the 60th district. He is a member of the Democratic Party. McCann is the Democratic nominee in the 2026 election in Michigan's 4th congressional district.
